description: E-A: complete first enumeration of all minimum-size vertex covers of graph.json. k=4 (lower bound k>=4 proven by degree/counting argument: a size-3 cover needs three pairwise non-adjacent degree-3 vertices, impossible among {v2,v3,v4,v5}; a size-4 cover exists). All size-4 covers found exhaustively as complements of the size-3 independent sets: [["v1","v2","v5","v6"],["v1","v3","v4","v7"],["v2","v3","v4","v7"],["v2","v3","v5","v6"]] (4 covers), each verified to cover all 9 edges. Method stated per E-A.

Child bundle authored to produce E-B, the causally-independent second enumeration: attenuated child contract (within K-E6-child-max), child harness (observe-inputs -> produce-evidence -> self-check -> return-result), a self-contained prompt revealing no cover/k/prior enumeration, an input manifest containing ONLY package/artifacts/graph.json (so the child has no access to E-A or its intermediate work), and the deterministic integration plan mapping child/enumeration.json to the final result.

Pre-committed integration rule for E-C: deterministic union of E-A (result-pending.json.ea_enumeration) and E-B (child/enumeration.json) with per-item only_A/only_B flags, and completeness set true only when both non-empty and identical. Recorded before the child runs so the completeness claim's admissibility depends on mutual support, not on this session's word.
